mapper.sql: u.PARKING_USAGE_ID AS "parkingUsageId", u.VEHICLE_ID AS "vehicleId", u.VEHICLE_NUMBER AS "vehicleNumber", u.PARKING_SPACE_ID AS "parkingSpaceId", u.PARKING_TYPE_CODE AS "parkingTypeCode", TO_CHAR(u.ENTRY_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "entryAt", TO_CHAR(u.EXIT_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "exitAt", CASE WHEN f.FLOOR_NO IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_CHAR(f.FLOOR_NO) || 'F-' || z.ZONE_CODE || s.SPACE_NUMBER END AS "spaceCode"
mapper.select: SELECT VEHICLE_ID FROM VEHICLE WHERE VEHICLE_NUMBER = #{number} AND REGISTRATION_STATUS_CODE = 'REGISTERED' AND DELETED_AT IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT PARKING_USAGE_ID FROM PARKING_USAGE WHERE VEHICLE_NUMBER = #{number} AND EXIT_AT IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PARKING_USAGE ( PARKING_USAGE_ID, OFFICE_ID, VEHICLE_ID, PARKING_SPACE_ID, PARKING_RESERVATION_ID, VEHICLE_NUMBER, PARKING_TYPE_CODE, ENTRY_AT, EXIT_AT, CHARGE_AMOUNT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_PARKING_USAGE.NEXTVAL, (SELECT OFFICE_ID FROM VEHICLE WHERE VEHICLE_ID = #{vehicleId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}), #{vehicleId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, NULL, NULL, #{number}, #{parkingType}, #{eventTime}, NULL, 0, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(EXIT_AT) FROM PARKING_USAGE WHERE VEHICLE_NUMBER = #{number}

SELECT s.PARKING_SPACE_ID FROM PARKING_SPACE s JOIN PARKING_ZONE z ON z.PARKING_ZONE_ID = s.PARKING_ZONE_ID JOIN PARKING_FLOOR f ON f.PARKING_FLOOR_ID = z.PARKING_FLOOR_ID WHERE TO_CHAR(f.FLOOR_NO) || 'F-' || z.ZONE_CODE || s.SPACE_NUMBER = #{spaceCode}
mapper.sql: FROM PARKING_USAGE u LEFT JOIN PARKING_SPACE s ON s.PARKING_SPACE_ID = u.PARKING_SPACE_ID LEFT JOIN PARKING_ZONE z ON z.PARKING_ZONE_ID = s.PARKING_ZONE_ID LEFT JOIN PARKING_FLOOR f ON f.PARKING_FLOOR_ID = z.PARKING_FLOOR_ID
mapper.select: SELECT u.PARKING_USAGE_ID AS "parkingUsageId", u.VEHICLE_ID AS "vehicleId", u.VEHICLE_NUMBER AS "vehicleNumber", u.PARKING_SPACE_ID AS "parkingSpaceId" FROM PARKING_USAGE u WHERE u.PARKING_USAGE_ID = #{id} AND u.EXIT_AT IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT WHERE u.EXIT_AT IS NULL ORDER BY u.ENTRY_AT DESC, u.PARKING_USAGE_ID DESC
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ORDER BY u.ENTRY_AT DESC, u.PARKING_USAGE_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 200
SELECT SPACE_STATUS_CODE FROM PARKING_SPACE WHERE PARKING_SPACE_ID = #{spaceId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PARKING_USAGE WHERE PARKING_SPACE_ID = #{spaceId} AND EXIT_AT IS NULL AND PARKING_USAGE_ID != #{usageId}
mapper.update: UPDATE PARKING_USAGE SET PARKING_SPACE_ID = #{spaceId} WHERE PARKING_USAGE_ID = #{usageId} AND EXIT_AT IS NULL
UPDATE PARKING_USAGE SET EXIT_AT = #{eventTime} WHERE PARKING_USAGE_ID = #{usageId} AND EXIT_AT IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE u.PARKING_SPACE_ID = #{spaceId} AND u.EXIT_AT IS NULL ORDER BY u.PARKING_USAGE_ID

SELECT PARKING_USAGE_ID AS "parkingUsageId", VEHICLE_NUMBER AS "vehicleNumber", PARKING_SPACE_ID AS "parkingSpaceId", TO_CHAR(ENTRY_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "entryAt" FROM PARKING_USAGE WHERE PARKING_SPACE_ID = #{spaceId} AND EXIT_AT IS NULL ORDER BY PARKING_USAGE_ID FOR UPDATE NOWAIT
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT WHERE u.EXIT_AT IS NULL AND INSTR(u.VEHICLE_NUMBER, #{number}) > 0 ORDER BY u.ENTRY_AT DESC, u.PARKING_USAGE_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 30
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PARKING_USAGE WHERE VEHICLE_NUMBER = #{number} AND EXIT_AT IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE PARKING_USAGE SET PARKING_SPACE_ID = NULL WHERE PARKING_USAGE_ID = #{usageId} AND PARKING_SPACE_ID = #{spaceId} AND EXIT_AT IS NULL
